artworks.title: Dream of the Rarebit Fiend: Bucking Automobile
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and brush and black ink over graphite, with printed overlay, on paperboard
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Moniz Family
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a comic strip titled "Dream of the Rarebit Fiend." The image includes a sequence of panels depicting a humorous situation involving a vintage automobile. Each panel contains detailed ink illustrations with text in speech bubbles. The story shows a series of misadventures with the car causing chaos. The style is typical of early 20th-century newspaper comics, with clear lines and shading. The comic uses exaggerated motion and expressions for humor, and it ends with a character waking up, indicating it was a dream.

artworks.title: Dream of the Rarebit Fiend: Here Comes Washington
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and brush and black ink over graphite, with printed overlay, on paperboard
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Moniz Family
artworks.description: There is a drawing of a comic strip called "Dream of the Rarebit Fiend." It shows a character in a striped pajama suit having a surreal dream. The panels show the character leaving Earth, observing it from a distance, encountering Earth's cities, and then waking up from the dream. The art style includes clear line work and cross-hatching for shading and texture. The backgrounds range from cosmic scenes to detailed cities. The text in the panels consists of dialogues and thoughts of the character, describing his observations and feelings, with a humorous ending about his dietary habits. The style is reminiscent of Winsor McCay.

artworks.title: The Lamps of God
artworks.medium: pen and black ink over graphite on paperboard
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Moniz Family
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various scenes featuring light and shadow. The top left panel shows a lighthouse with radiating light lines. To the right, there is a large sphere resembling the Earth with radiating light lines in the background. The right-most section depicts the facade of a classical building, with light casting shadows. The lower strip of panels shows a figure walking towards a radiant spot, a person reading under a lamp, a room with a bed illuminated by a light source, and a figure in a room with light coming through barred openings. The composition uses radiating lines to depict light and shade, connecting the scenes.

artworks.title: William Henry Powell
artworks.creditLine: Gift in honor of Alan Shestack from Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro
artworks.description: This image shows a man from the waist up. He is standing in a slight three-quarter pose with his body angled slightly to the side while his head faces forward. The man has a facial hairstyle, including a mustache and goatee, and short, wavy hair. He is wearing a dark suit jacket over a waistcoat with a patterned texture, a white shirt, and a bow tie. In his hand, he is holding a set of spectacles with a visible chain. The background of the photograph is plain.

artworks.title: Saint John the Baptist in the Wilderness with the Lamb of God, Surrounded by the Symbols of the Evangelists and the Four Fathers of the Church
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a circular composition with a central bearded man seated on a rocky landscape holding a staff. He is surrounded by various animals and ornamental foliage. Four smaller circular medallions around the central figure contain winged animals: an eagle, a bull, a lion, and a human figure with scrollwork and decorative patterns. Seated figures engaged in different actions are depicted outside of these medallions, with architectural elements in the background. The drawing is detailed with intricate line work and shading.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Civil War Soldier
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: This image is a framed portrait of a man standing in a composed manner. He is standing with his legs slightly apart, hands holding an object in front of him. The man has a smooth face with a neutral expression, dark voluminous hair, and is dressed in a long dark coat with boots. The background depicts an American Civil War setting with tents, a U.S. flag, a cannon, and soldiers in action. The scene is framed by vibrant foliage, trees, and a painted scenic vista within an ornate wooden frame with metallic accents.

artworks.title: Portrait of Three Young Men
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image shows three men sitting side by side from the waist up. The man on the left has his hands on his lap. The man in the center has his right arm around the shoulders of the man on the left, with his left hand on his own knee. The man on the right has his left hand on his knee. All three have serious expressions. The man on the left has short, slightly wavy hair. The man in the center has short, curly hair. The man on the right has shorter hair with a slight wave. They are dressed in formal attire: dark jackets, patterned waistcoats, light-colored shirts, and bow ties. The man on the left and the right wear dark bow ties, while the man in the center wears a lighter, checked bow tie. They are clasping each other's hands onto their respective knees. The background is plain, with a gradient from light to darker shades. The photograph is framed in an ornate, gold-colored frame with intricate detailing.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Civil War Soldier
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image is a full-body portrait of a man standing upright. He is posed facing forward with a rifle in his right hand and his left hand resting on a folded flag draped over a nearby support. His facial features include a serious expression, high cheekbones, and closely cut hair. The man is dressed in a dark military uniform consisting of a buttoned coat, chest straps, and a belt at the waist. He wears dark trousers, sturdy leather boots, and has a backpack or bedroll strapped across his back. The background features a painted backdrop of a stylized landscape with foliage and a cannon to his side.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Civil War Widow
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: This image shows a woman standing next to a small table. She is dressed in a dark, long-sleeved dress with a white collar. Her hair is neatly styled, and she has a composed expression on her face. She is resting her hand on the table, which has a decorative cloth draped over it. On the table, there is a black hat with a feather. The background is plain with a geometric patterned floor.

artworks.title: George E. Lane, Jr.
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Kathleen,  Melissa and Pamela Stegeman
artworks.description: The image shows a young boy seated and facing slightly toward the viewer. He has delicate facial features with large eyes and a slightly open mouth, exuding a calm expression. His hair is neatly combed to one side. He is wearing a buttoned-up outfit with a rounded white collar and striped fabric visible on the torso, along with darker plaid-like trousers. His right hand is resting on the side of his chair, and the left hand is partially visible. The photograph is presented in an ornate golden frame with intricate designs, with the name "Hamilton" inscribed on it. The background of the image is plain, focusing attention on the boy. The photograph shows signs of distress, such as spots and discoloration, typical of a vintage daguerreotype.

artworks.title: George E. Lane, Jr.
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Kathleen,  Melissa and Pamela Stegeman
artworks.description: The image displays an oval-framed portrait of a person's upper body, including the head, shoulders, and part of the torso. They face forward with a neutral expression, short dark hair, and wear a dark high-collared garment. The background is plain with a subtle gradient. The portrait is encased in a gold frame with decorative patterns and designs.

artworks.title: George E. Lane, Jr.
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Kathleen,  Melissa and Pamela Stegeman
artworks.description: The image is a vintage photograph encased in an open, book-like frame with a dark velvet lining on the left side and the photograph on the right. The image captures a young boy shown from the waist up. He stands upright, facing the camera, with his right hand resting on the back of a wooden chair that is painted white. The boy has short, neatly combed hair and a neutral facial expression. He is wearing a long-sleeved, patterned shirt with a collar and stripes running down the front, along with high-waisted trousers. The backdrop of the photograph is a plain, light-colored wall. The photograph's frame is ornate, with a gold-tinged border and noticeable age spots on the border's surface.

artworks.title: Captain Gideon Lane
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Kathleen,  Melissa and Pamela Stegeman
artworks.description: The image shows an older man seated, captured from the waist up. The man's facial features are characterized by a broad face, prominent nose, and a neutral expression. He has short, slightly wavy hair with sideburns. He is dressed in a formal dark suit, with a visible white shirt and cravat or bow tie. Marks or damage are present on the suit's shoulder area. The photograph is framed in an ornate gold case with a decorative edge. The background is plain and dark, centering the focus on the man's portrait.

artworks.title: Mrs. Gideon Lane
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Kathleen,  Melissa and Pamela Stegeman
artworks.description: The image shows an older woman sitting composedly, facing the camera. Her facial features appear delicate and wise, with a softly aged complexion. She has a center-parted hairstyle with curls framing her face. She wears a dark gown with a high collar and a white lace overlay. The setting is an ornate, oval-shaped gold frame. The background is dark, keeping the focus on the woman.

artworks.title: Waterloo Bridge
artworks.creditLine: Florian Carr Fund
artworks.description: We look across a river at an arched bridge spanning the width of this horizontal landscape. Created with smudges of pastel almost entirely in tones of cream and bright white, pale lavender purple, soft teal, and the faintest sky blue, the bridge seems nearly lost in a bright fog. The straight deck of the bridge divides the composition in half, though it angles slightly away from us toward the right. The four low arches of the bridge are powder blue and lilac purple with cobalt blue shadows underneath. Blended areas of light, spring green, azure blue, and pale yellow create a hazy sky above. Vertical lines in ultramarine blue could be smokestacks or towers in the distance on the far bank. The blue paper is visible and has darkened at the edges of the sheet. The artist signed the work in smoke gray in the lower right corner: “Claude Monet.”

artworks.title: Opus Filiae... Opus Praxitelis
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image features two sculptures of muscular male figures standing next to horses. The figures are depicted in confident stances, with curly hair and draped fabric. One of the figures leans against a broken statue fragment. The horse heads emerge from brick structures with some vegetation. The sculptures are in a grayscale tone, resembling classical statues. The background shows a textured sky with clouds. inscriptions above each sculpture read "OPVS FIDIAE" and "OPVS PRAXITELIS".

artworks.title: Equitum, in Quirinali, aversa parte
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two large equine statues with human figures standing on top of an ancient wall. The image depicts a pair of colossal horse statues with muscular human figures beside each equine structure. The wall looks old and built of bricks, with part of it serving as the base for the sculptures. The human figures are wearing classical draperies and standing in contrapposto, with one arm extended towards the horses. In the foreground, two smaller human figures appear to be analyzing the scene, with one gesturing upwards. In the background, there are subtle landscape elements, including rolling hills and a distant structure. Some rudimentary foliage grows around the ruin, indicating neglect or the passage of time. Cloud formations in the sky are depicted using cross-hatching techniques, contributing to the aged and historical aesthetic of the scene.

artworks.title: Our Pastor's Circle
artworks.creditLine: W. Bruce and Delaney H. Lundberg and Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image displays two panels of framed tintype portraits of women. Each panel features a four-by-three grid of photographs capturing the upper bodies of the women. The women face the camera directly, showcasing distinct hairstyles, facial features, and attire typical of the era. The frames around each portrait are elegant with gold-lined edges, set against a red velvet backing. The composition suggests a collection of portraits belonging to a family album or a historical record.

artworks.title: The Annunciation to the Shepherds
artworks.medium: charcoal with conté crayon on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Helen Porter and James T. Dyke, in honor of Margaret Morgan Grasselli
artworks.description: The image features a figure whose upper body is shown, in a crouching or kneeling position. The person's facial features are indistinct due to a soft blur effect, with blurred hair blending into the darkness. The figure's clothing is vague, matching the dim lighting. The person holds a long, thin object, possibly a staff or pole, with hands positioned closely around it. The background is dark with hints of soft light illuminating the figure. The environment lacks distinct details, creating a mysterious and somber atmosphere.

artworks.title: Title Page
artworks.creditLine: Patrons' Permanent Fund and Print Purchase Fund (Horace Gallatin and Lessing J. Rosenwald)
artworks.description: This is an image of an ornate calligraphic title. The drawing features text that reads "Apocalipsis cum Figuris" in a gothic and elaborate calligraphic style. The letters are adorned with intricate flourishes and decorative elements. The background is a plain, slightly textured, off-white paper that serves as a backdrop to the detailed black ink calligraphy. The overall presentation appears historical and possibly influenced by medieval manuscript titles, emphasizing the decorative nature of early book typography.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint John
artworks.creditLine: Patrons' Permanent Fund and Print Purchase Fund (Horace Gallatin and Lessing J. Rosenwald)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with various figures surrounding a character in a cauldron. The black and white line drawing shows multiple figures in detailed clothing gathered around the central character seated in the cauldron being heated by wood. The characters are dressed in period attire with different expressions, creating a sense of drama and tension. The background includes intricate architectural details, resembling a medieval cityscape. The drawing showcases technical skill in rendering fabric folds, facial expressions, and architectural details, with a style reminiscent of classical or Renaissance art.

artworks.title: The Vision of the Seven Candlesticks
artworks.creditLine: Patrons' Permanent Fund and Print Purchase Fund (Horace Gallatin and Lessing J. Rosenwald)
artworks.description: The image shows two full-body figures in a detailed black and white illustration. One figure is seated on a crescent shape surrounded by clouds, with long, curly hair, a beard, and a crown or halo. They wear elaborate robes, hold an open book and a thin object. The second figure kneels before the seated one in homage, with long hair and flowing robes. Surrounding them are ornate candlesticks with lit candles, against a background of stylized clouds.

artworks.title: Saint John before God and the Elders
artworks.creditLine: Patrons' Permanent Fund and Print Purchase Fund (Horace Gallatin and Lessing J. Rosenwald)
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring divine figures and a landscape. The upper portion shows a heavenly gathering of robed figures, cherubs, and a central figure seated on a throne, set in swirling clouds. Below is a terrestrial landscape with hills, a river, and a castle with a tower, surrounded by vegetation. The work is detailed and presented in a black-and-white woodcut style.

artworks.title: The Four Horsemen
artworks.creditLine: Patrons' Permanent Fund and Print Purchase Fund (Horace Gallatin and Lessing J. Rosenwald)
